InfraBot: Pager triggered — SEV2 for service inference-serving (eu-west1). Symptom: elevated 5xx on /v1/generate starting ~2026-03-17T10:42Z. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/incidents/inference-502

Anna: Ack, I'm on. Seeing ~15% 5xx on prod pool in eu-west1, p99 latency up. @Leo can you pull pod/node logs and check for driver errors or OOMs?

Leo: Looking now. Pod logs show repeated CUDA driver disconnects and occasional OOM messages.

Leo: ```
kubectl -n inference logs pod/model-worker-0a1b | tail -n 80
...
RuntimeError: CUDA driver lost
[WARN] "oom_killer invoked" for pid 4121
```

Anna: Plan: cordon + drain the worst nodes, scale up healthy replicas, and identify any infra change. Executing on node-12-eu.

Anna: ```
kubectl cordon node-12-eu
kubectl drain node-12-eu --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference
kubectl scale deployment/model-worker --replicas=28 -n inference
```

StatusPageBot: Draft status created: "Partial disruption in EU (eu-west1): some inference requests returning 502/503. Engineers investigating. Latest at 10:48Z." Preview: https://status.internal/redwood/incidents/1778001234

Anna: @Sara can you review and prepare a customer note? Recommend ETA 30m for mitigation; updates every 15m.

Sara: Reviewing. Proposed customer copy: "We are investigating partial 5xx errors impacting inference in eu-west1. Engineers are rolling back a recent kernel driver change; expected recovery within ~30 minutes. We'll update every 15 minutes." Will queue once we confirm rollback plan.

Nate: Correlated change found — a kernel module rollout from the maintenance batch applied to a subset of eu-west hosts overnight. Likely cause for GPU driver reconnects. I'll start rollback on affected hosts (node-12-eu, node-19-eu).

Leo: Rollback started on node-12-eu (1/3). Observability: error rate on that AZ down ~60% after rollback. No new OOMs in past 8m.

Anna: Rebalancing traffic back to healthy AZs; keeping cordoned nodes out of rotation until validated. Next status update in 15m. Handoff: @Leo owns post-mitigation checks, I'll draft the postmortem.

StatusPageBot: Status updated -> Identified. Suspected root cause: kernel module regression affecting GPU drivers. Next scheduled update in 15m.

Sara: Sent customer notification to impacted list at 10:59Z. Copy used: "We've identified a kernel driver change causing partial 5xx errors for inference in eu-west1 and have rolled back the change on affected hosts. Services are recovering; we expect full recovery within 15-30 minutes. A post-incident summary and maintenance schedule will follow."

Leo: Current metrics: 5xx trending back to baseline; p99 latency improving. No driver disconnects on rolled back hosts. Recommend scheduling planned maintenance to apply validated kernel and driver combos during a low-traffic window: propose 2026-03-18 02:00-03:00 UTC with canary on 2 nodes first.

Anna: Agreed. @Sara please draft the public maintenance announcement including the reason (kernel validation), canary plan, estimated impact (<30m for any small failover) and an opt-out contact for critical tenants. I'll create the internal oncall handoff template and postmortem outline.

Nate: I'll update the runbook with step-by-step rollback + validation steps: canary group, metrics to watch (no CUDA disconnects for 30m, no OOMs, 5xx baseline), and automated prechecks 1h before window.

Anna: Marking the incident mitigated at 11:04Z as error rates normalized on primary pools. Moving to 1h observation. Handoff to @Leo for follow-up validation and to produce the postmortem; @Sara to send final resolution to customers after 1h stable. Thanks everyone. :tada:
